title: Paginate with chunk
hints: `any` throws the element type away. Add a type parameter: `function chunk<T>(items: readonly T[], size: number): ...` — what should it return?
A list of pages where each page is a list of `T` is `T[][]`. Build it with a `for` loop that jumps `size` steps at a time.
for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += size) pages.push(items.slice(i, i + size));
